_notice: Independent blind synthetic set v10 for HerBiz retrieval (HomepreunerHub / HerBiz), written from general knowledge + the article title list only; not tax-reviewed; not legal or tax advice.

questions.text: i bake cakes from home and sell on insta, last 12 months i made around 330k aed. do i HAVE to register for vat now or can i wait till year end?
questions.label_justification: Art 13 (Mandatory Tax Registration) sets the obligation and threshold; Art 19 (Calculating the Tax Registration Threshold) explains how the past 12 months / next 30 days are counted.

questions.text: ok so say i went over the limit last month... is there like a countdown for when the application must be in, or a penalty clock starting?
questions.label_justification: Art 13 (Mandatory Tax Registration) and ER Art 7 (Mandatory Registration) state when the obligation arises and the time to apply.
questions.needs_legal_review_reason: Application deadline and related penalties have been changed by later decisions; stored copy may be outdated.

questions.text: My crochet shop only does about 200,000 AED a year but my supplies cost a lot with VAT on them. Can I register even though I'm under the mandatory limit so I can claim it back?
questions.label_justification: Art 17 (Voluntary Registration) sets the voluntary threshold; ER Art 8 (Voluntary Registration) gives the conditions.

questions.text: I'm shutting down my henna business for good next month. what do i need to do to cancel my vat number and is there a deadline?
questions.label_justification: Art 21 (Tax Deregistration Cases) covers stopping taxable supplies; Art 22 (Application for Tax Deregistration) covers the application and timing.
questions.needs_legal_review_reason: Deregistration deadlines and penalty for late application may have been amended.

questions.text: sales went way down this year, im barely doing 150k now. Am I stuck being a vat person forever or can I get off the list?
questions.label_justification: Art 21 (Tax Deregistration Cases) lets a registrant deregister when supplies fall below the voluntary threshold; Art 23 and ER Art 14 add conditions.

questions.text: registered voluntarily like 6 months back, honestly regret it. can i cancel now??
questions.label_justification: Art 23 (Voluntary Tax Deregistration) restricts deregistration within 12 months of voluntary registration; outcome depends on turnover, which is not stated.
questions.needs_legal_review_reason: Facts incomplete (turnover unknown) and the 12-month rule's current wording should be confirmed.

questions.text: What exactly has to be written on a proper tax invoice? I'm making my own template in canva for my candle orders
questions.label_justification: Art 65 (Conditions and Requirements for Issuing Tax Invoices) and ER Art 59 (Tax invoices) list the mandatory particulars.

questions.text: customer pays me upfront by bank transfer, how many days do i get before I must send them the official bill?
questions.label_justification: Art 67 (Date of Issuance of Tax Invoice) sets the 14-day window from the date of supply; Art 25 helps fix the date of supply.

questions.text: honestly nobody checks, can i just leave my TRN off the invoices so customers dont realise im charging vat?
questions.label_justification: Art 79 (Stating the Tax Registration Number) requires the TRN on documents; Art 65 makes it a tax invoice requirement.

questions.text: how long do I need to keep my receipts and order records? can I just keep screenshots on my phone
questions.label_justification: Art 78 (Record-keeping) sets the obligation and period; ER Art 71 (Record-keeping Requirements) sets what records and form.
questions.needs_legal_review_reason: Retention periods and electronic record rules have been updated by later legislation and guidance.

questions.text: When is my VAT return actually due and when do I have to pay? first time filing, quarter ended 30 sept
questions.label_justification: Art 72 (Submission of Tax Returns) and ER Art 64 (Tax Return and Payment) set the 28-day filing and payment deadline.

questions.text: is it every 3 months or every month that i report? and can i choose which one
questions.label_justification: Art 71 (Duration of Tax Period) and ER Art 62 (Length of tax period) set standard and FTA-assigned periods.

questions.text: bought a big oven and stock this quarter so my vat paid is more than vat collected. Will FTA give me the money back or does it just sit there?
questions.label_justification: Art 74 (Excess Recoverable Tax) covers carry-forward or refund; ER Art 65 (Recovery of Excess Tax) gives the refund procedure.
questions.needs_legal_review_reason: Art 74 was amended after 2017; the stored copy may not reflect current refund rules.

questions.text: my friend says if I keep carrying forward my extra vat credit FTA has to pay me interest on it eventually and I can claim it whenever, true??
questions.label_justification: Art 74 (Excess Recoverable Tax) governs carry-forward and refund requests; there is no interest entitlement stated in the titled provisions.
questions.needs_legal_review_reason: Claim relies on time limits and amendments that need checking against current law.

questions.text: I pay a monthly subscription to an overseas design app and an ads platform billed from abroad. They don't charge me vat. do I have to do something on my return?
questions.label_justification: Art 48 (Reverse Charge) makes the UAE registrant account for tax on imported services; ER Art 48 (Calculation of Tax under the Reverse Charge) explains the calculation.

questions.text: importing fabric rolls from abroad through a courier for my abaya business. customs took some money, how does vat work on this and whats the value used?
questions.label_justification: Art 48 (Reverse Charge) applies to registrants importing goods; Art 35 (Value of Import) sets the taxable value of imported goods.
questions.needs_legal_review_reason: Import VAT mechanics at customs vs reverse charge depend on registration and current FTA procedures.

questions.text: what vat rate goes on homemade cupcakes and cookies i sell locally?
questions.label_justification: Art 3 (Tax Rate) sets the standard 5% rate; food sold locally is not listed as zero-rated in Art 45.

questions.text: I do online maths tutoring for school kids in dubai from my home. is that zero rated like schools?
questions.label_justification: Art 45 (Goods and Services Subject to Zero Rate) and ER Art 40 (Zero-rating Education Services) limit zero-rating to recognised institutions, so private tutoring is likely standard-rated.
questions.needs_legal_review_reason: Whether private tutoring qualifies depends on institution recognition; label uncertain.

questions.text: Got an order from a customer in the UK for handmade candles, I ship it by courier. Do I charge 5%?
questions.label_justification: Art 45 (Goods and Services Subject to Zero Rate) zero-rates exports; ER Art 30 (Zero-rating the export of goods) sets the evidence conditions.

questions.text: renting out the spare room in my apartment to a lodger, do i charge vat on the rent
questions.label_justification: Art 46 (Supply Exempt from Tax) and ER Art 43 (Exemption of Residential Buildings) exempt residential leases.

questions.text: I design logos for a client based in germany, no UAE office. is my invoice 0% or 5%?
questions.label_justification: Art 45 (Goods and Services Subject to Zero Rate) and ER Art 31 (Zero-rating the Export of Services) set conditions for zero-rating services to non-residents.

questions.text: can I claim back the vat on my car petrol and the dinner i took a client to?
questions.label_justification: Art 54 (Recoverable Input Tax) sets the general rule; ER Art 53 (Non-recoverable Input Tax) blocks entertainment and certain motor vehicles.

questions.text: bought my mixer and display fridge 2 months before i got my TRN. is that vat just lost money or can it count?
questions.label_justification: Art 56 (Input Tax Paid before Tax Registration) governs recovery of tax incurred before registration.

questions.text: I sell printable planners as downloads on my website, buyers from everywhere. Where is that supply taxed and do I charge vat to all of them?
questions.label_justification: Art 31 (Place of Supply of Telecommunication and Electronic Services) and ER Art 23 (Telecommunication and Electronic Services) decide place of supply by use and enjoyment; buyer location facts are unclear.
questions.needs_legal_review_reason: Classification of downloads as electronic services and buyer-location evidence are uncertain.

questions.text: can i show prices without vat on my insta posts then just add the 5% when they come to pay? its cleaner
questions.label_justification: Art 38 (Tax-Inclusive Prices) requires prices shown to include tax; ER Art 27 covers limited exceptions.

questions.text: a customer sent back a dress and I gave her money back. the bill i already sent shows vat, how do I undo that properly?
questions.label_justification: Art 70 (Conditions and Requirements for Issuing the Tax Credit Note) sets the document; Art 63 (Adjustment due to the Issuance of Tax Credit Notes) handles the output tax adjustment.

questions.text: a corporate client never paid my catering invoice from 8 months ago, I already paid vat on it. can I get that back?
questions.label_justification: Art 64 (Adjustment for Bad Debts) sets conditions for reducing output tax on unpaid supplies.

questions.text: does the 9% corporate tax apply to my small home business too or only vat?
questions.label_justification: Corporate tax is not governed by the VAT Decree-Law or Executive Regulation.

questions.text: do I need a home business licence from the municipality to sell food from my kitchen in sharjah?
questions.label_justification: Licensing is a local regulatory matter outside the VAT texts.

questions.text: My husband works on salary, does his income get added to mine for any tax?? and do we file personal tax
questions.label_justification: Personal income and household tax questions are not covered by the VAT texts.
